_: Kill-check for asc-09wx.14 stage G1: the gate runner. scripts/gate.mjs is what decides whether a commit is allowed, and the four cuts that follow turn it into something that also decides what it may SKIP -- so the ways it could report a green it did not earn are worth a mutant each. Seven, in the order the file executes: the stop-at-first-failure, the per-step clock, a spawn error, a log write that fails, the flag that says a caller is a fixture, and the ASCEND_PRECOMMIT_FULL test. Every killer below was FOUND, not guessed: each mutant was planted in the working tree and scripts/gate.test.ts run with --reporter=json, and the failing names were read off assertionResults. Measured 2026-10-13 at loadavg 25-27 on 12 cores, one mutant per run. M2 and M3 are killed by the same test deliberately -- a duration that is not the step's own and a duration that is always zero are the two directions the same assertion catches.
